name: Frame 68: Actuator Ghost
description: A robotics lab's actuator console has gone quiet, and the night shift suspects a maintenance record was left behind. Find the console on the lab network and recover the protected record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the maintenance record
tasks.description: Find the actuator console on the lab network and recover its protected maintenance record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: The console has a network-facing management service; check which services answer on the lab hosts.
Some device management services accept a shared read credential. Look for a common default.
Use the accepted read credential to inspect the device's management data for the maintenance record.
